name: Buffalo Gap
title: Buffalo Gap Window Cleaning, Lakefront Estates | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for the Buffalo Gap Road lakefront estates. Waterfront glass, dock and boathouse windows quoted by photo; pure water, no ladders.
intro: Buffalo Gap Road holds about 20 high end waterfront estates on Lake Travis. CleanzATX cleans the glass on these homes with pure water, and Tyler Durham quotes each one himself, usually from a few photos.

sections.h2: What Buffalo Gap homes are like
paragraphs: About 20 estates sit along Buffalo Gap Road on the lake, priced from $2.85M to $4.25M. This is a road based lakefront group rather than a formally named subdivision, and it is not gated. There is no HOA in the records.

Waterfront at this level means large homes, long views and sometimes outbuildings such as a boathouse or dock. Each property is different, so we do not quote from a table. We ask for photos and a rough square footage, and we price from there.

sections.h2: What Buffalo Gap windows deal with
paragraphs: Here the glass sits closest to the water, and it takes more weather than glass farther back. Lake mist leaves hard water spots that can etch if they stay. Wide windows facing the water catch afternoon sun and show every streak. Pure water leaves no film for that light to find.

Docks and boathouses add their own work. If you have glass on a dock, boathouse or pool house, we can look at it from the photos and tell you if our poles can reach it. Birds, spiders and lake dust gather on glass near the water more than you would expect.

Access is simple because there is no gate, but the drives and slopes toward the water can be steep. Send us a photo of the approach, and tell us where we can park. We run pure water from the truck and use water fed poles from the ground to reach up to three stories, so no ladders go on lawns, terraces or steps. Houses this size pair well with soft washing for stone, stucco and the roof.
For a 5,000 sq ft home, exterior windows come to about $500 at $0.10 per sq ft. Plan on a long half day, roughly four to five hours, for the outside of a house that size.

why: Waterfront glass takes the most mist, so we treat hard water spots
Dock, boathouse and pool house glass can be quoted from photos
Long views mean low sun streaks, which pure water avoids
Not gated, so Tyler can plan the day around your schedule

faq.q: Can you clean boathouse or dock windows?
faq.a: If the glass is on your property and we can reach it with poles from solid ground or a dock, yes. Send photos and tell us how to get to it, and we will say what is practical.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for a big waterfront home?
faq.a: Text us photos of the house and a rough square footage or window count. We reply with a quote, usually within the hour during business hours.

faq.q: Will lake spray spots ever come off?
faq.a: Fresh spots usually do. Old spots that have started to etch the surface may only improve, and we tell you honestly before we start. Removal is $10 per pane.

faq.q: Is pressure washing safe for natural stone?
faq.a: We soft wash stone, stucco and roofs. We never pressure wash limestone. Patios and decks near the water are cleaned by hand.

faq.q: How often do waterfront windows need cleaning?
faq.a: Many lakefront homes do well on a Quarterly plan at 15% off, or Every 2 Months at 20% off. Those plans include hard water removal on up to 5 windows each visit.
